page.overview:
Who is Air Commandos?

SkyMATE is a G.I. Joe character who was introduced in 1991 as part of the Air Commandos subset of the G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero toy line.

* Specialty: Glider Trooper/Air Commando.

* Background: He is an Australian Special Air Service (S.A.S.) trooper. His character file describes him as having grown up on a remote station, where he learned skills with traditional weapons like boomerangs, knives, and woomeras (spear throwers) before getting specialized weapons training.

* Characteristics: He is noted for being tough, quiet, and fast.
